competency_questions: Which distinct benchmarks and datasets appear across the retrieval-augmented generation papers, and which paper evaluates on each?
If a RAG paper cites a dataset only as background or motivation but reports no experimental results on it, is that dataset included in the list?
Are datasets that are subsets or splits of a larger benchmark (e.g. a specific split of MS MARCO) listed as separate datasets from the parent benchmark, or grouped under it?
briefs.definition: The set of distinct benchmarks and datasets that each retrieval-augmented generation paper in the corpus reports results on, mapped to the papers that evaluate on them.

measure.filter: paper is a retrieval-augmented generation paper and the dataset is reported as an evaluation benchmark in the paper's experiments

needs: identification of which corpus papers are retrieval-augmented generation papers (topic, method or title/abstract evidence)
experiments or evaluation sections of those papers naming the benchmarks/datasets used
dataset identifiers or names so distinct datasets can be de-duplicated across papers

scope.datasets: all benchmarks and datasets (including named corpora, leaderboards and split-specific sets) that such a paper explicitly evaluates on in its experiments
scope.papers: all corpus papers whose topic or method is retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), including variants that augment a language model with an external retrieval source

briefs.title: Evaluation benchmarks and datasets of RAG papers

question: Which benchmarks and datasets do the retrieval-augmented generation papers in the corpus evaluate on?
